title: Fidelity rollout two-track checkpad and release notes - March 2026 (draft)
body:
Purpose:
This is a short, pragmatic two-track rollout plan intended for mid-sized feature launches where we need both a fast path for low-risk traffic and a fidelity path for validation against quality/regression metrics. Use as a day-of cheatpad and as the source of truth for the release-notes draft.

Scope and audience:
- Scope: small-batch model-serving changes + API route adjustments + console telemetry tweaks.
- Audience: release conductor, on-call SRE, model-owner/ML engineer, product PM, docs owner.

What we mean by two-track:
- Fast path: 0->10% traffic rapid ramp for non-critical tenants. Purpose: confirm infra behavior and basic latency.
- Fidelity path: 1% seeded cohort with aggressive eval hooks and quality gating (prompt-eval, regression tests). Purpose: catch regressions in generation/quality before wider roll.

Preflight (48-24h) - owners in parens:
- Confirm canary build tag created and pinned (owner: release-conductor).
- Verify perf snapshot: 95/99 p95/p99 latency baseline for candidate vs prod (owner: SRE). Attach raw numbers.
- Model/weight checksum + artifact manifest uploaded (owner: ML infra).
- Smoke test matrix created and linked (owner: Eng QA). See Smoke tests list below.
- Telemetry hooks enabled for routing and model variant (owner: telemetry).
- Rollout policy configured in gateway: percentage ladder + safety hold (owner: infra-config).
- Slack channel created and invited: #release-fidelity-{shortid} (owner: release-conductor).
- Stakeholder readout scheduled 30m pre-launch (owner: PM).

Day-of timeline (hours relative to start):
- T-60m: Final go/no-go triage. Confirm all preflight items green. (All)
- T-30m: Warmup lanes deployed (n=3 warmup requests per worker). Confirm KV cache warms. (SRE)
- T-0: Deploy fast-path routing rule (0->1% over 5m). Start observability timer. (infra)
- T+10m: Verify latency, error rate, and smoke tests for fast-path. If any fail, PAUSE and investigate.
- T+30m: If fast-path stable, ramp to 10% over 20m. Trigger fidelity seed (1% on separate cohort). (infra + ML owner)
- T+60m: Evaluate fidelity evals (prompt sets) and regression alerts. If quality delta > threshold, begin rollback. (ML + QA)
- T+120m: Decision point to continue ramp to 50% or stop and hold. (PM + SRE + ML)

Smoke tests (short list - run automatically and by hand):
- Basic API sanity: /generate returns 200 and sample token length within expected bounds.
- Auth/quotas: rate-limited request returns 429 with correct header.
- KV cache hit: repeated prompt returns <20ms token generation for cached prefix.
- Streaming SSE: stream completes without dropped frames >0.1% in sample.
- Embedding parity: same input before/after returns cosine similarity > 0.998.
- End-to-end sample prompt set (10 canonical prompts) compared against golden outputs: compare high-level metrics, not exact text.

Quality gating thresholds (fidelity path):
- Prompt-eval pass rate >= 95% across seed set (metric: rubric pass/fail).
- Generation latency median within +20% of baseline.
- Error budget consumption for route < 1% of allowed during window.
- No new 5xx class errors in top-agg traces.

Rollback criteria (automated + manual):
- Automated: error rate > 1% absolute increase OR p99 latency > 2x baseline for > 10m. Auto-signal triggers pause of ramp and rollback to previous tag.
- Manual: fidelity eval fail rate > 10% or recurring functional regression reported by product owner.

Surge contingency map (if traffic spike happens):
- If 2x expected traffic: scale policy auto-burst allowed up to 2 additional nodes; notify infra lead.
- If 5x traffic or resource constraint: divert newly routed fast-path traffic to canary-bypass and drain fidelity cohort; open Sev-2 war room.
- If storage/kv pressure: engage cache invalidation window and disable background rehydration for 1h.

Communications (templates):
- Slack short update (T+10m): "[release-id] fast-path at 1% -> checks running. No regressions observed in first 10m. Monitoring: latency p50/p95/p99: X/Y/Z, errors: N. Next step: ramp to 10% in 20m unless blocker."
- PM customer note (post T+120m if successful): "Rolling out update X. Some customers were in early cohort; no material regressions observed. Full rollout planned over next 24h."

Release notes (live draft):
- Title: March 2026 fidelity rollout - model-serving improvements and API stability fixes
- Short blurb: Ship: improved attention kernel selection for long-context workloads, streaming stability fixes, and telemetry for route-level token costs.
- Highlights (bullet):
  - Reduced p99 latency by ~8% for 2k token workloads in internal perf runs.
  - Streaming disconnect handling fixed for intermittent network backpressure.
  - New telemetry: per-route token cost breakdown (beta).
- Impact notes: No API contract changes. Customers using pinned tags will not see changes.
- Migration notes: N/A. For private deployments, operators must update runtime-plugin to v0.9.2.
- Known issues: Small cohort of prompts with long numeric tables may see slightly higher repetition under heavy prefix cache contention - monitoring in place.
- Contacts: release@redwood.ai, support@redwood.ai, PM: Priya Singh.

Post-release retrospective prompts (fill within 48h):
- Were the fidelity eval thresholds appropriate? Adjust?
- How did telemetry perform for detecting regressions? Any missing hooks?
- Any surprises with cache warmup behavior?

Open questions / TODO (owner tags):
- Add synthetic traffic generator for fidelity cohort to expand prompt variety (owner: QA).
- Hook the prompt-eval results into the console rollout dashboard for next release (owner: console).
- Confirm docs owner will publish release notes to docs site and changelog (owner: docs).

Quick action items (today):
- Evan to attach the perf snapshot and golden prompt outputs to this doc.
- Diego to add the Linear checklist with exact ticket numbers.
- Aisha to run the final smoke run at T-15m and paste results in channel.

Appendix - quick checklist (tick boxes for day-of):
- [ ] Canary tag built and deployed to staging
- [ ] Telemetry hooks verified in staging
- [ ] Slack channel and war-room link present
- [ ] Smoke tests green in staging
- [ ] Warmup traffic executed
- [ ] Fast-path ramped to 10% without alerts
- [ ] Fidelity evals passing threshold
- [ ] Release notes draft posted to docs repo

Notes to self: keep the fidelity cohort as small but diverse; we care more about signal quality than speed for that track. If the fidelity path flags an issue, prefer to stop and investigate rather than rely on rate-based rollbacks alone.

-- end --
